description:
Aggregate the work that makes repository validation one pure function in the validation layer, over records parsed once, with its resolvers, defaults and compiled rules stated once.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One pure validation-layer function computes the repository report from a captured validation and injected inputs, the history verdicts among them only when its caller is a named history reader.
- [hard] REQ-02: The validation layer's production code imports nothing from `commands`.
- [hard] REQ-03: Item links resolve against one address index with item kinds resolved once; issue-id prefixes match container pointers and coverage labels without allocating.
- [hard] REQ-04: Whole-repository validation parses the index and each issue file once, through one loader, and every pass, record fidelity included, consumes those parsed issues; each schema compiles once per report.
- [hard] REQ-05: Plan-document references, the content-format default and the strictness default each come from one function.

## Notes

`crates/jit/src/validation/record_fidelity.rs` adds a record-fidelity pass to whole-repository `jit validate`: stored index, issue, gate-run and event-log records must decode and reproduce what the writer would publish. It reads every gate run and the whole event log, so only whole `jit validate` and the built-in `repository_validation` gate checker run it, as the history readers f8a6b298 names under its DEC-19. It reaches the report with document-reference resolution as an optional history input, and the repository checker judges through the same function, history included, so a gate cannot pass where `jit validate` fails.
title: One pure validation report over parsed records
